summary: Discover and read canonical incoming assistant replies independently of agent restarts

replay.detail: Uses normally admitted and projected canonical messages. Existing retained-reference upgrade revalidation is unchanged; no resend, record replacement or database repair.

schema.detail: Local recipient/time reply-read indexes support bounded source seeks. No storage version or signed-data changes.

rules.detail: Admission, signature verification, native transcript handles, generic search and write authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The existing conversation list accepts replies=true for authenticated-principal-only incoming reply metadata. Its complete read handles use the existing conversation reader, pin immutable sent-claim identities and bind principal, grant and policy. Native conversation listing remains available without this mode.

downtime.detail: No coordinated rollout or service downtime is required by the read contract.

manual.detail: Refresh MCP tools, discover replies with replies=true and pass returned read objects unchanged to the reader. Long replies use bounded next_range continuations.

recovery.detail: No new migration or recovery path. Revoked or expired grants and policy-invalidated handles remain refused.
